required_public_repository_url_policy: credential-free HTTPS GitHub repository URL ending in .git; concrete repository remains UNSET until a real anchor is preregistered
required_anchor_claim_boundary: Git ancestry and byte identity establish only that the signer-registry bindings were publicly frozen before the later execution commit. They do not prove trusted wall-clock time, human identity, qualification, independence, or absence of conflicts; those properties still rely on the external verifier attestation and escrow evidence.

claim_boundary.git_history_establishes: The named anchor bytes were already present at the named ancestor commit and remain byte-identical.
claim_boundary.git_history_does_not_establish: That any key holder is human, independent, conflict-free, or qualified, or that Git commit timestamps are trusted wall-clock timestamps.
claim_boundary.identity_qualification_basis_after_ancho: The independently obtained external verifier attestation and its public/private escrow evidence, with the external-verifier key pinned by the prior public anchor.
